fields.statement: Verified at b5f725e3. Read the diff: captureInterview (shared by session interview and session done, session_run.go:462) now skips any answer whose question equals, verbatim, the question field of a live Decision the change set's ops created, or once landed a live Decision derived-from the session's Sources, and reports it in skipped. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/session-(interview|done)' -count=1: ok (session-interview, -landed, -source, -recorded, session-done-captures). session-interview-recorded.txtar covers the acceptance: with a Decision 'Which colour?' only answer-<sid8>-2 is proposed and answer-1 is reported skipped; a Decision 'Which store' (one character off) does not stop answer-2; with the record change set landed and a landed Decision derived-from the session's Source carrying 'Which colour?', the record capture writes only the 'Which store?' answer. Mutation check: with session_interview.go reverted to HEAD~1 in a scratch worktree, the script fails at line 34 (answer-158fe87f-1 proposed). go test ./internal/api/...: every test passes except TestReadBudget (roadmap what-if timing median over 50ms at load average ~6.5), a read-path timing budget this diff does not touch. gofmt clean.
